replacements.label: Page introduction
replacements.find: These terms are designed to keep the program clear, fair, and aligned with the message and values of The Divine Blueprint.
replacements.value: These terms are designed to keep the program clear, fair, and aligned with the message and values of The Divine Blueprint.

replacements.label: 1. Commission text
replacements.find: The standard ambassador commission is 15% of qualifying sales attributed through the approved referral system for eligible products, unless a specific campaign states otherwise.
replacements.value: The standard ambassador commission is 25% of qualifying sales attributed through the approved referral system for eligible products, unless a specific campaign states otherwise.

replacements.label: 2. Tracking text
replacements.find: Ambassadors must use their assigned referral method when promoting eligible products. Sales attribution is determined by the records of the approved affiliate platform.
replacements.value: Ambassadors must use their assigned personal referral link when promoting eligible products. Sales attribution is determined by the referral identifier recorded with the qualifying completed checkout.

replacements.label: 3. Completed Sales text
replacements.find: Commission applies only to valid completed transactions. Cancelled, fraudulent, disputed, reversed, or refunded transactions do not qualify.
replacements.value: Commission applies only to valid completed transactions. Cancelled, fraudulent, disputed, reversed, or refunded transactions do not qualify.

replacements.label: 4. Ethical Promotion text
replacements.find: Ambassadors must promote the book honestly and accurately. False claims, deceptive advertising, spam, impersonation, or misrepresentation are prohibited.
replacements.value: Ambassadors must promote the book honestly and accurately. False claims, deceptive advertising, spam, impersonation, or misrepresentation are prohibited.

replacements.label: 5. Claims text
replacements.find: Ambassadors must not claim that purchasing or reading the book guarantees wealth, healing, marriage, promotion, miracles, breakthrough, or any other outcome the book does not promise. The book should not be presented as a replacement for Scripture, the local church, pastoral guidance, or appropriate professional care.
replacements.value: Ambassadors must not claim that purchasing or reading the book guarantees wealth, healing, marriage, promotion, miracles, breakthrough, or any other outcome the book does not promise. The book should not be presented as a replacement for Scripture, the local church, pastoral guidance, or appropriate professional care.

replacements.label: 6. Brand text
replacements.find: Official graphics, videos, excerpts, captions, and other materials supplied for ambassador use may be used to promote The Divine Blueprint. They must not be altered in a way that misrepresents the author, the book, The Gleaning Ground, or the program.
replacements.value: Official graphics, videos, excerpts, captions, and other materials supplied for ambassador use may be used to promote The Divine Blueprint. They must not be altered in a way that misrepresents the author, the book, The Gleaning Ground, or the program.

replacements.label: 7. Intellectual Property text
replacements.find: Participation does not transfer ownership of the book, companion resources, logos, graphics, videos, or other intellectual property. Ambassadors may not reproduce, upload, resell, share, or distribute unauthorized copies of the book or companion materials.
replacements.value: Participation does not transfer ownership of the book, companion resources, logos, graphics, videos, or other intellectual property. Ambassadors may not reproduce, upload, resell, share, or distribute unauthorized copies of the book or companion materials.

replacements.label: 8. Paid Advertising text
replacements.find: Ambassadors who intend to run paid advertisements using the book title, author name, ministry name, or official branding should obtain approval before launching those advertisements.
replacements.value: Ambassadors who intend to run paid advertisements using the book title, author name, ministry name, or official branding should obtain approval before launching those advertisements.

replacements.label: 9. Self-Referral text
replacements.find: The program is intended to reward genuine referrals to new customers and should not be used primarily as a personal discount mechanism.
replacements.value: The program is intended to reward genuine referrals to new customers and should not be used primarily as a personal discount mechanism.

replacements.label: 10. Program Updates text
replacements.find: Eligible products, commission arrangements, campaign offers, and program terms may be updated when necessary. Material changes will be communicated to affected ambassadors when appropriate.
replacements.value: Eligible products, commission arrangements, campaign offers, and program terms may be updated when necessary. Material changes will be communicated to affected ambassadors when appropriate.

replacements.label: 11. Removal text
replacements.find: The Gleaning Ground may remove an ambassador for fraud, abuse, misrepresentation, unauthorized distribution, unethical promotion, or conduct that materially harms the book, author, ministry, customers, or program.
replacements.value: The Gleaning Ground may remove an ambassador for fraud, abuse, misrepresentation, unauthorized distribution, unethical promotion, or conduct that materially harms the book, author, ministry, customers, or program.
